title: Clinical Trial Failures: stopped clinical trials classified by why they stopped
description:
Terminated, suspended and withdrawn trials from ClinicalTrials.gov, classified by the sponsor's stated stop reason into biological failure signals (efficacy, futility, safety) and non-biological causes (recruitment, funding, strategy, regulatory), with the evidence span each label rests on. Where the registry text gives no cause, reviewed per-trial decisions from the sponsor's SEC filings, the trial's own publication and the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) supply it, each with its source. Trials with posted results are read for whether the primary endpoint was met or missed. Rebuilt weekly; browse it at clinicaltrialfailures.com.
